problem: A report/permission answer can be durably appended to the native commission event log and the host can crash before TaskAgentManager._take_up_again has durably moved the commission. Re-asking loses an already accepted answer; blindly replaying active work is unsafe.

authority_boundary.effect: N.E.K.O call audit + existing managed effect-safety patches

reuse_search.L0_authority: Keep all state in existing N.E.K.O ledger/events and task-agent transcript authority.

reusable: Ledger events are durable SQLite rows
TaskAgentManager._take_up_again resumes the existing transcript tail
PermissionGate grants are in-memory/current-authority and must not be reconstructed
L1_neko_current_pin.gap: _answer_closed writes answered event then invokes in-memory resume; no startup consumer exists for an answer committed immediately before host death.

L2_neko_upstream_extensions.result: Latest upstream still fails prior-host queued/working/waiting_user in Ledger._reconcile and _answer_closed still only owns report resume; no durable accepted-answer restart seam exists.

reuse_search.L3_existing_pinned_external: Not applicable: pinned providers/surfaces do not own host-internal accepted-answer continuation.
reuse_search.L4_broader_external_ecosystem: Durable workflow/approval engines can model this, but would duplicate the frozen N.E.K.O ledger/orchestrator/permission authority.
reuse_search.L5_thin_integration: Selected: write a restart-answer envelope into the existing Ledger event log and let TaskAgentManager consume only a still-current matching waiting_user checkpoint on the next host use.

safety_rules: Envelope must carry the exact current question id.
Recovery only consumes when commission is still task_agent + waiting_user and the durable question id still matches.
Permission envelope stores continuation text only; it never stores or recreates once/session/always grants.
Recovered permission work must encounter current PermissionGate again before a protected effect.
If status became working before crash, this unit does not auto-replay it; ambiguous active work remains fail-closed under the parent blocker.
retirement_condition: Delete when upstream N.E.K.O natively persists and consumes accepted report/permission answers across host restart with equivalent stale-id, cancellation, no-grant-restore and no-active-effect-replay semantics.
